qt: to the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Thierry Mariani (PfE), Virginie Joron (PfE) Subject:

The EU recognises and commemorates several genocides, including the Holocaust, the genocide of the Tutsis in Rwanda in 1994, the Srebrenica genocide in 1995, the Holodomor, and the genocide of the Yazidis committed by ISIS. Over the past 30 years, violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is reported to have caused the deaths of around 10 million people, and massacres continue in the east of the country. The Congolese authorities and numerous civil society organisations are calling for these crimes to be recognised as ‘genocost’, i.e. a genocide perpetrated for economic gain. 1.

Can the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy indicate whether she intends to recognise the ‘genocost’ in the Democratic Republic of the Congo?
Does she support the establishment of an independent international investigative mechanism to determine responsibility, in particular that of Rwanda, since 1996?
